result.question: What comes to the old prophet at the table?

readings.support: the word of the LORD came to the prophet who had brought him back

assessments.reason: The verse says, “the word of the LORD came to the prophet who had brought him back” while they were at the table; this matches “the word of Yahweh.”

result.reason: The passage explicitly says the word of the LORD came to the prophet at the table, matching the key.
